import hashlib,json,os,sys
from pathlib import Path
assert sys.flags.isolated and sys.dont_write_bytecode
root=Path("/Users/zacheryspector/studio-scratch/1370-c0-s1-exact-source-comparator-proposal-r6")
review=Path("/Users/zacheryspector/studio-scratch/1370-c0-s1-exact-source-comparator-independent-review-r6/RECEIPT.json")
manifest_pin,code_pin,recorder_pin,inputs_pin,outer_pin,review_pin=sys.argv[1:7]
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert str(root) not in sys.path and not root.is_symlink()
mb=(root/"MANIFEST.json").read_bytes();assert sha(mb)==manifest_pin
code=(root/"compare.py").read_bytes();assert sha(code)==code_pin
rec=(root/"recorder.py").read_bytes();assert sha(rec)==recorder_pin
ib=(root/"INPUTS.json").read_bytes();assert sha(ib)==inputs_pin
outer=(root/"outer.py").read_bytes();assert sha(outer)==outer_pin
rb=review.read_bytes();assert sha(rb)==review_pin
assert json.loads(rb)=={"decision":"ACCEPT_STATIC_EXPLORATORY_ONLY","package":"1370-C0-S1-EXACT-SOURCE-COMPARATOR-R6","manifestSha256":manifest_pin,"compareSha256":code_pin,"recorderSha256":recorder_pin,"outerSha256":outer_pin,"inputsSha256":inputs_pin}
os.environ["S1_COMPARE_EXTERNAL_MANIFEST_SHA256"]=manifest_pin
os.environ["S1_COMPARE_EXTERNAL_REVIEW_SHA256"]=review_pin
sys.argv=[str(root/"compare.py"),*sys.argv[7:]]
exec(compile(code,str(root/"compare.py"),"exec"),{"__name__":"__main__","__file__":str(root/"compare.py"),"_EXTERNAL_CODE":code,"_EXTERNAL_REVIEW":rb})
